headline: Tanker Giant Frontline Posts $642 Million Q3 Profit on Record Bookings
summary: Frontline reported net income of $642 million in the third quarter of 2026, driven by its highest tanker booking rates on record. The company expects 2026 to be its most profitable year ever.
why: Frontline is one of the world's largest sea oil tanker operators, serving as a direct indicator of global maritime crude trade volume and freight rates.

impacts.name: Frontline
impacts.why: Frontline beat quarterly earnings forecasts on record tanker charter rates.
